name: Tasipimidine
summary: Tasipimidine is an α2-adrenergic receptor agonist which is approved for the short-term treatment of fear and anxiety in dogs. It is also under development for the treatment of insomnia in humans. The drug is used as an oral solution in dogs, whereas its route of administration for humans is unspecified.

pharmacology.text: Tasipimidine (INN, USAN; developmental codes ODM-105 and ORM-19695; brand name Tessie) is an α2-adrenergic receptor agonist which is approved for the short-term treatment of fear and anxiety in dogs. The drug acts as a potent and selective full agonist of the human α2A-adrenergic receptor.
pharmacology.kind: α2A-Adrenergic receptor agonist; Anxiolytic; Sedative; Hypnotic
